ban.title: Take action on user
ban.subtitle: {{email}} · {{orgs}} orgs, {{projects}} projects

soft.title: Soft ban — block login only
soft.body: Account stays. Their projects keep running for end customers. Fully reversible from this page.

hard.title: Hard ban — suspend everything
hard.body: Block login AND mark all their projects inactive (customers' storefronts go dark). Reversible (login); projects must be re-activated manually.

nuclear.title: Delete account — irreversible
nuclear.body: Cascade-delete user + orgs + projects + products + orders. Use only for fraud / legal takedown.
